reconstruction.summary: Python C-API wrapper around free function H0PP_getRescale. Takes (symbol:str, date:int), creates a stack SecInfo, and returns the rescale ratio as a Python float. Parse failure returns NULL (Python None after CPython error).
reconstruction.semantic_contract: getRescale(symbol: str, date: int) -> float | None
reconstruction.behavioral_notes: 1) First argument is a symbol name (Python str or bytes) converted to C char* via PyUnicode_AsUTF8String or PyBytes_AsString. 2) Second argument is a date encoded as int via PyLong_AsLong. 3) On PyArg_ParseTuple failure, returns NULL with an error set. 4) Underlying free function creates a stack SecInfo and delegates to SecInfo::getRescale (method at 0x0010b790). 5) Return value is built with Py_BuildValue("d", double) using format string at S_0010fc04. 6) The free function returns 1.0 on the failure path (DAT_0010fd18 = 1.0), which is also the mathematical identity for ratio.
side_effects: libpinot_reader.so is dlopened during PIN_CALLBACK handler init; handler resets qword at SecInfo+0x28 (price callback slot)
Uses PIN_Abort on unresolved symbol addresses during initialization
